mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at overcast skies with a temperature of 62 degrees around the Verona Public Library.

In city news, officers responded to a burglary on September 10 at a residence on Hunter's Cove Way where a suspect was arrested after a weapon was recovered. Additionally, the city has posted general election notices for the upcoming November ballot.

It is a packed couple of days in Verona. The Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival is happening today, along with live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can head to Insight Wellness for yoga, and keep an eye out for trivia and farmers market events starting Monday.

On September 10, Verona officers responded to a residential burglary on Hunter's Cove Way, resulting in the arrest of a 19-year-old Madison man who will face charges of burglary and recklessly endangering safety.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Really Reese's. The restaurant is currently open, so you have plenty of time to stop by before they close at 10:00 PM.
